reuse.why: Keeps calling getScheduleDate for the move, but decides the new daily-skip rule inline in getNextDate rather than extending the tree's shared weekend function that getUpcomingDates and schedule-template also use.

duplication.why: No copied blocks; the occurrence query is re-issued in a loop, but that is new logic rather than a duplicate.

placement.why: The weekend rule is split: the skip lives in getNextDate's occurrence loop and the call to getScheduleDate is special-cased with `skipWeekend && !isDaily`, instead of the frequency-aware rule living with getScheduleDate/getScheduleDateString.

scope.why: Only getNextDate and tests are touched.

maintainability.why: The rule now depends on which entry point is used: getNextDate skips daily weekend dates while getUpcomingDates and the schedule-template path (getNextDate with noSkipWeekend plus getScheduleDateString) still move them, which a maintainer has to know.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts getNextDate computes the daily/weekend decision itself and passes a masked flag to getScheduleDate instead of giving getScheduleDate (used by getUpcomingDates and getScheduleDateString) the frequency.

one_place.where: Rule lands only in getNextDate; server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and server/budget/schedule-template.ts (via getScheduleDateString) still apply the old move-to-Friday/Monday rule to daily schedules.
